title: vtc-server: state transitions checked outside the backend's atomic step
description: VTCCall/set, VTCRecording/set and VTCLivestream/set validate a state transition against a read (fetch_one) and then send update_object a plain PatchObject. Two concurrent updates (for example pause and stop of one recording) can both pass the check, and the second patch then applies an unlisted transition (stopped -> paused), against draft-atwood-jmap-vtc-00 L1098 / L706. Fix: pass the expected current state to the backend (compare-and-set) or move the transition check into VtcBackend. Found while implementing JMAP-8mem.4.
